bootstrap_scheme: fresh numpy.random.default_rng(seed) per (q, statistic); idx = rng.integers(0, n, size=(n_boot, n)); 2.5 / 97.5 percentiles of the resampled mean (or median); the transmission ratio is recomputed on every resample (resamples with |mean d smoothing| <= 1e-09 are dropped)

criterion.a: ci_mean_hi < 0 of the mean paired difference s - (same sampler, s = 1) at BOTH q
criterion.b: no run passing G-A (final tier) with the eta part of G-N (|eta_dev - eta_final| <= 0.001) under s = 1 fails it under s
criterion.note: pre-registered criterion (descriptive, not a gate); no selection rule and no protocol change follow from it

decomposition: gap = g2_at_0 - e2_at_0; smoothing = g2_at_0 - smoothed_e_pred_0; remainder = smoothed_e_pred_0 - e2_at_0 (final tier, utils.ms_noise.decompose_gap); *_rel = / g2_at_0; smoothing_over_formula = smoothing / (g2_at_0 * sigma_effort_at_0_t2 / (sqrt(pi) * q))
noise_record_check: NL runs: the decomposition against rule_log.json stages[2].freeze.noise (absolute 1e-09 for gap, smoothing, remainder, e_sigma, e2*(0), e_hat; relative 1e-05 for sigma and the smoothing / formula ratio, whose per-run sigma is the verifier's float32 value); a disagreement is a flag in the row's flags column

transmission: ratio = mean(d gap) / mean(d smoothing), d = arm - s=1 of the same sampler (the PI's -(change of the gap) / (change of the smoothing part) read as reduction over reduction: 1 = the whole smoothing change reaches the gap, 0 = the remainder offsets it)
